capability: Use Light as the first-launch and fail-closed shell theme default while preserving valid persisted theme choices
searchEvidence: rg -n 'ShellPreferenceSnapshot.Default|SelectedTheme|ThemeChoices|LoadShellPreferences' src/NvtFwCombiner.Presentation.Avalonia tests/NvtFwCombiner.UiSmoke.Tests identifies ShellPreferenceSnapshot.Default as the file-store fallback and MainWindowViewModel.SelectedTheme as the in-memory initialization consumed by the existing Settings theme choices.

ShellViewModelTests.Preferences.cs already covers missing, invalid, unsupported-schema, persisted Dark, persisted Light, and persisted System snapshots; this slice changes only the missing/invalid default expectation and retains the existing serializer and supported choices.
semanticOwner: ShellPreferenceSnapshot.Default owns the serializable shell preference fallback, and MainWindowViewModel initializes SelectedTheme from that same canonical snapshot
terminalContract: Fresh, missing, or invalid shell preferences default to Light. Valid persisted System, Light, and Dark values remain preserved. No preference schema, layout, theme-token, updater, firmware, profile, range, CRC/header, Golden, output-naming, or release behavior changes.

designReview.evidence: R1 owner-approved UI default change reuses the existing ShellPreferenceSnapshot and MainWindowViewModel preference path; no independent design reviewer is required.
